name: Avataro Sentai Donbrothers
description: 21 years ago, a baby arrived on earth inside of a peach. Today, five warriors based on the legend of Momotaro fight enemies that are inhabiting humans, invisible to the naked eye. Together they fight to take back gears based on previous Super Sentai.

videos.title: We've Got A Bond Now - Director's Cut
videos.overview:
A director's cut of episode 50, released on the TTFC app.

Taro visits his friends and asks them how they felt about joining the Donbrothers. The other Donbrothers sense something strange about Taro. According to Kaito, something happened to Taro who had just finished his work. Meanwhile, the executioner Sonona appears...

videos.title: Avatarō
videos.overview: A man finds a baby in a peach that fell from the sky. 21 years later, a high school girl loses everything and is tasked to find Tarou Momoi.

videos.title: Big Peach, Little Peach
videos.overview: Haruka continues her search for Tarou Momoi as he causes a woman that he works with to seek for a way to become younger.

videos.title: Clearing a Thief
videos.overview: Haruka unknowingly comes face-to-face with Tarou Momoi while he is on duty as a deliveryman; people all over are having their house lights stolen, including a new member of the team.

videos.title: The Onigiri Oni
videos.overview: Tarou takes a temp job with Tsuyoshi's company; Haruka and Shinichi wonder if they can trust Tarou.

videos.title: The Dog Won't Come Out
videos.overview: Tsubasa is corned by the police outside of Tarou's job, taking a clueless Haruka hostage in the process.

videos.title: Kiji's Fleeting Power
videos.overview: Tsuyoshi feels self-conscious about going to a party with his wife, unknowingly using mysterious "points" to improve his status after talking with a coffee shop owner.

videos.title: Herd of Teachers
videos.overview: Haruka signs up for a special class that ends up being taught by Saruhara; Tsubasa and Tsuyoshi chase down a vigilante Hitotsuki.

videos.title: A Slave to Long Hair
videos.overview: Tsuyoshi and Tsubasa bond over their lovers; an artist becomes frustrated about there being no muse for him at the restaurant when he stumbles upon Miho.

videos.title: Ramshackled and Robotarō
videos.overview: Haruka and Shinichi must feed Tarou to make him feel better; a child seeking playtime turns into a Hitotsuki.

videos.title: The Second Try Oni
videos.overview: Haruka uses Kibi Points to quit the Donbrothers, but another Oni Sister shows up in her place.

videos.title: Inu's Heatstroke
videos.overview: Tsubasa becomes sick after a run in with the police, putting himself in the care of Tsuyoshi who doesn't know what to do.

videos.title: I Think You're a Liar
videos.overview: Tarou outs a co-worker for stealing food, causing everyone to be mad at him; Kaito hires a new employee at the coffee shop, which Haruka instantly dislikes.

videos.title: Farewell Tarou
videos.overview: After Tarou attempts to lie in order to praise the team, Shinichi gets fed up and has the team boycott.

videos.title: Jirou the Substitute
videos.overview: After Tarou is slain by Sonoi, a man called Jirou Momotani heads to the big city with dreams of being a hero.

videos.title: Welcome Back, Tarou
videos.overview: After using too many points to bring back Tarou, bad things start happening to Haruka and Shinichi.

videos.title: The Dark Side Switch
videos.overview: Jirou just wants to be friends with his new teammates.

videos.title: Light and Tsubasa
videos.overview: Tsubasa hopes to see Natsumi again on the one year anniversary of her disappearance.

videos.title: Unlike a Shark
videos.overview: Tarou offers Jirou the opportunity to be his equal by way of a punishment game; Don Murasame makes his presence known.

videos.title: Hello, Ghost
videos.overview: After being scolded by her aunt for being on the phone all of the time, Haruka discovers the ghost of a girl inside of a phone booth.

videos.title: The Big Nose Elegy
videos.overview: Jirou gets a call from his girlfriend who is coming to Tokyo and wants to lead the Donbrothers to impress her.

videos.title: A Very Ramen-y Path
videos.overview: Shinichi is mistaken for someone else upon transforming into Saru Brother; Sonoza's love of Haruka's manga gets the best of him and he kidnaps her.

videos.title: The Hellish Manga Journey
videos.overview: Haruka remains forced to create a sequel to her manga for Sonoza, but cannot get out of her slump.

videos.title: The Dog Becomes a Dog
videos.overview: A boy sets up a shrine for his late pet when Tsubasa disturbs it and is caught in a curse.

videos.title: A Son and Two Working As One
videos.overview: Tarou delivers a package to a woman who mistakes him for her son.

videos.title: The Professional Heroes
videos.overview: Tsuyoshi is fired from his job, but miscommunication arises when he airs his grievances to Tarou.

videos.title: Ready For the Finale
videos.overview: After watching the Kamen Rider Revice finale, Kaito decides that Donbrothers shall end too and wants to determine an MVP.

videos.title: A Fixated Duel
videos.overview: While enjoying a nice day at the pool, Tarou is challenged to a duel by Sonoi.

videos.title: The Secret of Secrets
videos.overview: Tsubasa is spotted outsmarting some cops by a young woman who has her eye on something that she wants to steal.

videos.title: A Funeral and Murasame
videos.overview: Tarou is invited to Sonoi's funeral while Murasame asks Jirou about the meaning of life.

videos.title: The Juuto Hunter
videos.overview: Haruka's aunt is kidnapped by Anoni in exchange for the Donbrothers to help them with the Juuto.

videos.title: A Barking Face Reveal
videos.overview: Upon realizing that their team still isn't complete, Tarou decides to take matters into his own hands to find out who Inu Brother really is.

videos.title: The Second Duel
videos.overview: Sononi and Sonoza challenge Tarou to a duel and everyone has a bit of deja vu.

videos.title: The Master of Bringing it Together
videos.overview: Jirou cares for a barely alive Tarou as Sonoi tells the other Donbrothers of their leader's downfall.

videos.title: Natsumi Meets Me
videos.overview: Tsubasa asks Tsuyoshi for that dinner he promised when they first met; both the Donbrothers and Nouto take issue with Sonoi now acting like Tarou.

videos.title: The Origami Song
videos.overview: Tsuyoshi is dejected about Miho leaving to be with Tsubasa; the police reveal that they are conducting an investigation on the Juuto.

videos.title: Counterfeit Dog Fight
videos.overview: The others try cheering Tsuyoshi up while the Juuto disguised as Tsubasa runs amok in the city.

videos.title: One, Two, Three and Four
videos.overview: The Nouto are getting too attached to the Donbrothers and so the senate sends Sonoshi to supervise.

videos.title: Cooking Gibberish
videos.overview: Kijino invites everyone to a fancy dinner with his reward money while a food critic who has lost her appetite roams about.

videos.title: The Button That Fell From the Shelf
videos.overview: The Donbrothers are cleaning the shop when they stumble upon a button that unleashes Don Killer.

videos.title: Dangerous Riding Partners
videos.overview: Haruka is signed up for driving school when Sononi notices that Tsubasa is being targeted by Don Murasame.

videos.title: Trouble Making Santa
videos.overview: The Nouto have something to ask the Donbrothers when it's revealed that Santa is running around causing trouble as a Hitotsuki.

videos.title: The Family Leaving You Speechless
videos.overview: Saruhara is greeted by a scam artist and decides to create a fake family with the other Donbrothers to expose him.

videos.title: Finding the Answer and Getting a Riddle
videos.overview: Inuzuka remembers who saved him from the Juuto forest; Haruka discovers the true identity of her rival, Naoki Shiina.

videos.title: Exposed White, Exposed Black
videos.overview: Sononi convinces Tsubasa to once and for all defeat the Juuto that stole Natsumi's face.

videos.title: Kakamura, Gagamura
videos.overview: Tsubasa asks if he can join Tarou and visit Jirou's hometown of Kakamura after becoming engulfed in Naoki Shiina's manga.

videos.title: Natsumi's Dream of a Lifetime
videos.overview: Tarou is now one with the Juuto forest as Sonoshi and his new friends give a warning to Sonoi and company.

videos.title: A Don-Nou Meeting
videos.overview: The Donbrothers and Nouto have a meeting to consider Sonoi, Sononi and Sonoza joining the team.

videos.title: The Donbros Have Nine People
videos.overview: Now that Sonoi and company have officially joined the Donbrothers, the team must work together to save Tarou and Tsuyoshi.

videos.title: Final Memories
videos.overview: Tsubasa tries to help Tsuyoshi forget about Miho; Sonoshi stirs the pot by finding someone with unlimited Hitotsuki possibilities.

videos.title: Looks Like We've Made a Bond
videos.overview: With Tarou losing his memory, he learns just how much his team has grown.
